description: Vertical laptop dock — two swept arch ribbons joined at end-feet, with slots the closed laptop slides into edge-down. Ships in two variants: the original single-slot stand (18 mm slot) and a dual-slot stand that holds two laptops side by side (18 mm front slot, 16 mm rear slot). Both are fully parametric — set the slot widths to your laptops' thicknesses.
printing_notes: The arch crown is nearly horizontal (~2° slope near the crest), so at a uniform 0.2 mm layer height each layer becomes a ~5 mm wide terrace. Enable adaptive/variable layer height down to 0.08 mm over the top ~30 mm of the arch to avoid visible stair-stepping.
Matte filament hides the remaining layer lines on the curved faces; set the seam position to Back so it lands on the rear of the ribbons.
